Text: Greetings, Mortal. My servants tell me I can get my attire cleaned in this esteemed... establishment?
(Dry) Correct, I clean clothes.
(Bubbly) Yes, silly! Didn't you see the huge neon sign that says "Clean for the Mean"?
(Fresh) Nice, looks like word of my "esteemed establishment" got around.
Indeed. Would you be able to return this shirt to its original, pristine condition?
Tell me, are you experienced in cleaning blood stains?
(Dry) I'm in business with evil. Getting rid of blood is my bread and butter.
(Bubbly) Oh, that's a big one! The other guy didn't live to tell the tale, I imagine. Good on you!
(Fresh) Blood? That looks more like wine to me, Pookie.
It's a big stain and I can assure you it's blood. Blood indeed.
And not wine at all...
I should know, I'm a Vampire Elder. Baronex Duskmantle of Midnight's Keep to be exact.
(Dry) It smells like wine, it looks like wine. I will treat it like wine.
(Bubbly) But it smells like... Ooh, got it. Of course dear Baronex, I will totally get rid of this BLOOD stain for you!
(Fresh) Whatever the stain, I'll make sure to get that shirt back on you asap.
I shall return to collect the garment tomorrow. I hope your services will please my sophisticated taste.
It's a big stain and I can assure you it's blood. Blood indeed.
My victim lost a lot of it when I fed on them last night. I'm a Vampire Elder, you see.
Baronex Duskmantle of Midnight's Keep to be exact. Enchanté...
Pray do tell, have you ever worked for a Vampire before? Most common folk find us most... frightening.
(Dry) Most my clientele is dangerous. I am confident my excellent services will keep me in business. And alive.
(Bubbly) A real Vampire Elder? I'm positively thrilled! But don't worry. I'm not scared. Most my clients are kinda dangerous.
(Fresh) I got many dangerous customers but none look as sharp as you. The bloodlust suits you well.
You are a gutsy one! Living here amongst such murderous creatures can't be easy.
Sometimes even a Vampire can feel discouraged around such marvelous villainy.
Especially if this theoretical Vampire was inept at hunting prey...
Which is not me, of course! I'm an exceptional hunterex! Confirmed by the blood stains on my shirt which are NOT wine at all.
I'm looking forward to collect my garment tomorrow. And to see you again, dear Mortal.
Hey, you the one doin' laundry, right?
I got some oil on this work-overall. Can you get it out?
(Dry) Certainly. Looks like motor oil. Shouldn't be a problem.
(Bubbly) Sticky stuff, but I can get it out. I don't want a cutie like you running around with motor oil stains.
(Fresh) Motor oil, synthetic blend. Stubborn, but I'll get it out.
Yeah, I needed to fix somethin' on my Mistress's orbital laser.
Got quite dirty in the process.
You know how Super Villains are: The bigger the laser, the better.
(Dry) Super Villains. Most of them are just rich brats, not understanding the intricacies of crime.
(Bubbly) Gotta love a big laser! And a dirty henchwoman.
(Fresh) Well, you need a big laser to scare the shit out of these plebs.
Yeah, whatever... I need this overall cleaned.
If you don't suck, I'll come back. I'm sure my Mistress will have me crawl inside some machinery again soon.
She is quite...
(Bubbly) Cool?
(Fresh) Incompetent? Annoying?
Demanding.
Anyway, I'm out. Do your job well and I'll return with more shit to clean.
You sound like you know what you're talking about. I respect that.
These higher-ups act like they are the shit but they don't know that people like us make the world go round.
I'll be a good customer for you, ya know. My Mistress has me climb in all sort of shit.
So I have a lot of laundry that needs taking care of.
(Dry) I always take care of my customers.
(Bubbly) I'd love to take care of you- ehm... Of your clothing.
(Fresh) Just don't bring in anything too nasty. I don't do contagious stuff.
Right. Just get that oil stain out and I'll be happy as a clam.
And trust me, you don't want to see me unhappy.
Gree...tings. Mo- mo... ortal...
(Dry) Hello.
(Bubbly) Are you okay? Do you need a glass of water? Or uhm, a goblet of blood?
(Fresh) Damn, what got you lookin' all sweaty?
I ju... I just went for a nice evening... stroll.
A stroll that included vigorous running and jumping. And a very small tumble on my part.
If you could take care of my hunting cloak, I would be most obliged.
(Dry) Maybe you shouldn't hunt. Successful vampires let their prey come to them.
(Bubbly) Oh gosh... Maybe you should let people come to you in the future instead of running after them.
(Fresh) Why do you need to go hunting anyway? Throw a party or something. I'm sure people would come in flocks.
Thank you for your... input. But let's focus on the task at hand. My hunting cloak!
There are some grass stains on it and sweat.
But it's not my sweat! That would be quite unbecoming of a Vampire Elder of my standing.
(Dry) The sweat of your victim, perhaps?
(Bubbly) Awww, but it's not embarrassing to be a little sweaty. It happens to all of us.
(Fresh) Yeah, sure. That's also why your forehead is NOT covered in sweat.
Just clean it please. That's what I'm paying you for, isn't it.
My sweet Mortal, that is indeed a splendid suggestion!
I shall try it. A dinner party perhaps, or a soirée, or even... a cheeky get-together.
I'd invite YOU of course but alas, you need to clean my cloak. I apologize, dear One.
I think there is a grass stain from my tumble and some sweat.
Please don't tell anyone that I can actually sweat. That would break my dark, unbeating heart.
(Dry) I have no interest in gossiping.
(Bubbly) Aww, but why not? I think it would make you more approachable!
(Fresh) Yeah, I won't tell anyone. Probably...
I trust you won't tell anyone for you haven't given me any reason to doubt you.
I can't wait to see you again, my Dear.
Ugh...
(Dry) Hello.
(Bubbly) Oh, you look kinda sad. What's wrong?
(Fresh) You look like shit. What happened?
Being a henchwoman is just the fucking worst. I can deal with the dirt, the insults, the violence, even the irregular working hours.
But the evil schemes this woman comes up with... They're just dumb!
(Dry) Sounds like you should get rid of her. Or replace her.
(Bubbly) Oh, that's horrible. I'm sorry to hear... You should switch roles with her. That'll teach her.
(Fresh) Usually henchwomen don't complain so much. Maybe you should become a villain instead.
Me replacing her? Tss, that's not how it works, soap-nerd.
Anyway, my Mistress' last ingenious plan was to punish the pizza-guy next to our secret lair.
He discontinued her favorite pizza, so she kidnapped his baby.
Now I have to watch that brat until the guy surrenders or dies or whatever. Fucking GREAT idea, if you ask me.
(Dry) I didn't ask. But that explains the stains.
(Bubbly) Ah baby?! Omg that's sooo cute!
(Fresh) So you have to take care of the baby now? Gross...
It's fucking annyoing... I got drool and babyfood stains all over my work-clothes.
But that's your problem now. Take care of it for me, okay sweetcheeks?
You think I should become a Super Villain? That's insane... But maybe you're on to something.
I sure as fuck would be better at making evil plans. You know what she did?
She was angry at the pizza-guy next door because he discontinued her favorite pizza.
She could've blown up the shop, poisoned the marinara sauce, cut off his fingers, anything...
But she decided to kidnap his baby. And now I have to take care of it.
I mean, look at my clothes! They're full of baby food and drool!!!
(Dry) I'll just clean the stains for you, I don't need a backstory.
(Bubbly) That's horrible! Your evil plans are a million times more wicked than hers.
(Fresh) Well, that's a stupid fucking idea. But cutting off his fingers? Come on...
Anyway, what's done is done. And I need you to get these stains out.
I'm glad I can count on you. You really are good at your job, soap-nerd.
I got a thing for nerds, ya know. I like how they get nervous and shit. It's cute.
You are a proper genius, sweet Mortal. I did what you recommended.
I hosted a lavishly decadent tupperware party. They practically BEGGED me to grant them entrance.
Like sheep to the slaughter. It was positively divine!
And I picked the plumpest one to join me for the after party... The blood on my silken night-blouse is that was left of her.
(Dry) Sounds like a successful night.
(Bubbly) Oh, it sounds wonderful! I'm so sad I missed it. Especially the after party.
(Fresh) Your silken night-blouse? A tupperware party??? Come on dude, where's the carnage?
It was a titillating night... I haven't indulged in the pleasures of flesh and blood in a long time.
You'll discover stains of my favorite massage oils on there too. We were utterly naughty before, well... I killed her.
(Dry) I really, REALLY do not wish to hear more about your titillating night.
(Bubbly) Sounds like you had a lovely night. Her too, up until the end at least.
(Fresh) Yeah, that's more like it! Tell me more about the blood. Was it gushing? Splattering?
I don't want to bore you with any more details. Just know, the night was a big success, thanks to you.
Maybe I'll invite you to one of my parties one day.
(Dry) I will decline.
(Bubbly) That would be amazing. I love parties, tupperware, and sexy vampires!
(Fresh) I might show up, as long as it isn't a fucking tupperware party.
We'll see what the future brings... Or at least I will. You humans have preposterously short life-spans, right?
Especially if there are ravenous vampires lurking around. Vampires that just got reminded of the sweet taste of blood.
I don't want to bore you with any more details. Just know, the night was a big success. Thanks to you, my Dear.
There was a one thing though that left a bad taste in my mouth after all.
I was missing you, my Dear. Your wit, your dauntlessness, your bewitching eyes...
Thoughts of you follow me, wherever I go. Like the scent of detergent, softly lingering in the ether.
(Dry) And just like ink on a white shirt, you will never get rid of me.
(Bubbly) Did you just compare me to... laundry detergent? That's not how you romance a hottie like me.
(Fresh) You lost me with the detergent thing, sorry. Don't you wanna talk about blood again?
That is the dauntlessness I was talking about. Who would dare to speak to a Vampire Elder that way?
I take great delight in your company and in being your customer. I am certain that you will get rid of these oil and blood stains.
But I'm also plagued by dark thoughts, my Dear.
To know that you, a human, will have to perish one day... Accepting that feels almost insurmountable.
But regardless, I will leave you to your work. I'm sure I will be greatly satisfied as always, dear One.
Yo, I did it! I got rid of that incompetent roach of a Super Villain.
I didn't kill her or anything. I just locked her in one of her torture-labyrinths. Which I built FIY.
She'll never find her way out of it, ha! And I'm the new Villain in town.
I got a Super Villain overall now too. I don't fuck with spandex.
(Dry) A bit uninspired but overalls are easier to clean anyway.
(Bubbly) An overall? Really? Isn't that a bit boring? There are such cool spandex suits out there...
(Fresh) So what do you fuck with?
Well, I... Wanted to talk about the stains on my overall, actually. Look, there's a bunch of sweat and blood on it.
I like the look of it but this thing reaks. I need it cleaned before I execute my next evil plan. Which...
(Dry) I do not wish to hear your evil plan. I will not be an accessory to a crime.
(Bubbly) Oh, yes! Tell me your evil plan. I NEED to know!!!
(Fresh) Oh sick, are you seriously gonna tell me your evil plan? Isn't that usually a secret or something?
You know what, nevermind. I'm not gonna tell you my plan.
Which I definitely have. And that is super elaborate and like super dark and twisted...
(Dry) Okay.
(Bubbly) Aw man... You sure? I bet it IS really cool and elaborate and twisted.
(Fresh) That's so lame, dude. Why tease it then?
Maybe it was my PLAN to have you guess. Ya know, another scheme from the Blue Collared Menace.
Which is my Super Villain name btw. Blue... Collared... Menace...
So get these stains out or my next plan might involve a certain laundry shop.
Actually, I don't really have an evil plan yet.
Turns out, I'm a great henchwoman but a fucking horrible schemer.
My old Mistress was terrible at it too, don't get me wrong. But it's actually a lot harder than I thought.
That's also the reason I came to you. I feel like you're smart.
And being a business-person or whatever is not easy. Not in this shit economy.
Sooo, what I'm saying is... Do you maybe wanna work together sometime?
I know you got your laundry thing going and I still need you to get rid of these blood and sweat stains.
But maybe you have time for a little side hustle?
(Dry) Interesting proposition. Maybe I do have time for a side hustle in crime.
(Bubbly) Working together with you sounds fun! But I'm more of a lover than a fighter, I think.
(Fresh) So I'm supposed to be your henchling? Fuck no...
In any case, you helped me out last time. Saying I should replace my Ex-Mistress and all.
For a nerd, you're kinda cool. And you smell like soap. I like that.
